name: vertical-slides
body:
A letter suffix (e.g. `3a-…`) makes a reveal.js vertical slide under numbered slide 3, ordered by letter; one level only. A numbered slide that has letter slides renders as a vertical stack whose first slide is that numbered slide's own content and whose following slides are its letter slides in letter order. A letter slide without its number slide = error; duplicate number+letter = error.

Acceptance criteria: with slides `1-intro.md`, `1a-detail.md` and `1b-more.md`, the rendered stack's first child is the content of slide 1, and slides 1a and 1b follow beneath it in letter order; the numbered slide's own content is visible as the first slide of its stack, with no dummy empty slide.
